skill_name: Describe the geology of the Rocky Mountains
workflow: The Rocky Mountains are a massive mountain range that spans the western US, starting in Montana and extending south to New Mexico. The Rocky Mountains form part of the American Cordillera and are composed of mainly sedimentary and igneous rocks. The highest peak, Mount Elbert in Colorado, reaches a height of 4,401 meters.
